question: 创业板指同一天的收盘点位是多少？
answer:
生成查询代码
SELECT 
    m.TRADEDATE AS `交易日期`, 
    m.INDX_SNAME AS `指数名称`, 
    m.SECCODE AS `指数代码`, 
    ROUND(m.TOPEN, 2) AS `开盘价`, 
    ROUND(m.THIGH, 2) AS `最高价`, 
    ROUND(m.TLOW, 2) AS `最低价`, 
    ROUND(m.TCLOSE, 2) AS `收盘价`, 
    ROUND(m.LCLOSE, 2) AS `昨收`, 
    ROUND(m.CHNG, 2) AS `涨跌额`, 
    ROUND(m.CHNG_PCT, 2) AS `涨跌幅(%)`, 
    ROUND(m.TVALUE/100000000, 2) AS `成交额(亿)`, 
    ROUND(m.TVOLUME, 0) AS `成交量`, 
    m.DEAL AS `成交笔数`
FROM 
    INDX_MKT m
WHERE 
    m.SECCODE = '399006'
    AND m.TRADEDATE = '2026-08-31'
    AND m.ISVALID = 1;
